hi:browser.BrowserSetupCard.4.en: If you already have Murage for Chrome installed, set it up here.

hi:browser.BrowserSetupCard.15.text: Murage for Chrome खोलें और इसका हेल्पर कनेक्ट करें।

Corrected string: {name} अपने अलग टैब में आपके लॉगिन का उपयोग करता है। Murage बॉट को उन्हीं टैब तक सीमित रखता है और पासवर्ड भरने व भुगतान करने का काम आपको सौंपता है। हर साइट के लिए चुनाव और पूछने के स्तर मेरा Chrome, साइन इन में मिलते हैं।

hi:browser.extensionScope.en: {name} can use tabs you share, signed in as you. You choose each site's access, and actions that send, post or change something need separate approval.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: Conecte a extensão e escolha o perfil de navegador dela antes de continuar.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: Connect the extension and choose its browser profile before continuing.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: Retome a tarefa de navegador na extensão antes de continuar aqui.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: Resume the browser task in the extension before continuing here.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: Browser tools are off for {value0}. Turn them on in {value1}'s settings, then choose Continue again.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: A escolha de navegador mudou. Abra a aba Navegador para concluir a configuração.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: The browser choice changed. Open the Browser tab to finish setup.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: A escolha de navegador mudou. Verifique-a e escolha Continuar novamente.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: The browser choice changed. Check it, then choose Continue again.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: A conexão do navegador mudou. Verifique-a e escolha Continuar novamente.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: The browser connection changed. Check it, then choose Continue again.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.text: Não foi possível continuar a tarefa. Envie uma nova mensagem quando estiver pronto.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-extension-s.en: The task could not continue. Send a new message when you are ready.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.text: A escolha de navegador de {value0} mudou nesse meio-tempo. Escolha novamente.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.text: Outro bot está usando seu Chrome. Primeiro, mova-o para um navegador próprio.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.en: Another bot is using your Chrome. Move it to its own browser first.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.en: {value0} is using your Chrome. Move it to its own browser first.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.text: O navegador antigo não confirmou o fechamento.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-mode-transi.en: The old browser did not acknowledge closing.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-open-chrome.text: Abra o Google Chrome neste computador e tente novamente.
pt-br:browser.server.browser-open-chrome.en: Open Google Chrome on this computer, then try again.

pt-br:browser.server.browser-open-chrome.en: Open Google Chrome on this computer, then try again.

pt-br:browser.server.route.2.en: Choose the browser profile in the Browser tab.

pt-br:browser.server.route.3.text: Este perfil do navegador não está mais disponível. Escolha um perfil na guia Navegador.
pt-br:browser.server.route.3.en: This browser profile is no longer available. Choose a profile in the Browser tab.

pt-br:browser.server.route.4.text: Outro bot está usando seu Chrome, ou a conexão anterior ainda está sendo encerrada.
pt-br:browser.server.route.4.en: Another bot is using your Chrome, or the old connection is still closing.

pt-br:browser.server.route.5.en: Paused for you · Hand back first

pt-br:browser.server.route.7.en: Review the browser choice before pairing this agent.

zh:browser.yourchrome.ask.text: {name} 需要使用你的登录信息。今后改用你的 Chrome 吗？
zh:browser.yourchrome.ask.en: {name} needs your logins for this. Use your Chrome from now on?
zh:browser.yourchrome.ask.note: Reason: 登录信息 suggests credentials instead of the existing signed-in state used by this route. Corrected string: {name} 需要使用你已登录的网站来完成此操作。今后改用你的 Chrome 吗？

zh:browser.switchback.text: 已从 {previous} 切换。切换回去

zh:browser.BrowserChoice.13.text: 你的 Chrome 连接方式

zh:browser.BrowserPreflight.1.text: 在 Chrome 中打开 chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging 并将其开启，保持 Chrome 打开，并在 Chrome 询问时点击“允许”。Chrome 重启后会再次询问。
zh:browser.BrowserPreflight.1.en: Open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging in Chrome, turn it on, keep Chrome open, and click Allow when Chrome asks. Chrome asks again after it restarts.
zh:browser.BrowserPreflight.1.note: Reason: 将其开启 does not name the debugging capability being enabled. Corrected string: 在 Chrome 中打开 chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging，开启远程调试，保持 Chrome 打开，并在 Chrome 询问时点击“允许”。Chrome 重启后会再次询问。

zh:browser.BrowserSetupList.1.text: 需要设置 Chrome 的机器人

zh:browser.BrowserSetupList.3.text: 将这些机器人移至各自的浏览器
zh:browser.BrowserSetupList.3.en: Move these to their own browsers

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.2.text: 设置后还会在此工作区启用浏览器工具。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.2.en: Set up also enables browser tools in this workspace.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.3.text: 此步骤为可选。如果你选择不连接，你的请求仍会保留在此对话中。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.3.en: This is optional. Your request stays in this conversation if you choose not to connect.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.4.text: 如果你已安装 Murage for Chrome，请在此处进行设置。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.4.en: If you already have Murage for Chrome installed, set it up here.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.10.text: 在 Chrome 中打开 chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging 并将其开启，保持 Chrome 打开，并在 Chrome 询问时点击“允许”。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.10.en: Open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging in Chrome, turn it on, keep Chrome open, and click Allow when Chrome asks.
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.10.note: Reason: Name remote debugging explicitly instead of 将其开启. Corrected string: 在 Chrome 中打开 chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging，开启远程调试，保持 Chrome 打开，并在 Chrome 询问时点击“允许”。

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.12.text: 从 Chrome 应用商店添加 Murage for Chrome。浏览器会请你确认安装。然后打开其侧边栏进行连接。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.12.en: Add Murage for Chrome from the Chrome Web Store. Your browser asks you to confirm the install. Then open its side panel to connect.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.13.text: 打开 Chrome 应用商店

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.14.text: 打开 Murage for Chrome 并连接其辅助程序。此版本使用未打包的开发版扩展程序。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.14.en: Open Murage for Chrome and connect its helper. This build uses an unpacked development extension.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.15.text: 打开 Murage for Chrome 并连接其辅助程序。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.15.en: Open Murage for Chrome and connect its helper.

zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.16.text: 在扩展程序中共享一个标签页。如果它已暂停或停止，请先检查页面并在那里恢复。
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.16.en: Share a tab in the extension. If it is paused or stopped, check the page and resume there first.
zh:browser.BrowserSetupCard.16.note: Reason: A stopped task cannot be resumed in the extension; Continue here starts a new task. The extension's Resume button is 继续. Corrected string: 在扩展程序中共享一个标签页。如果任务已暂停，请先检查页面并在扩展程序中点击“继续”。如果任务已停止，请在此处选择“继续”以启动新任务。

zh:browser.choiceCheck.text: 请再次尝试检查此浏览器选择。

zh:browser.chromeSummary.en: Your Chrome · Uses your logins in tabs of its own

zh:browser.releaseFailed.text: {name} 无法关闭旧的浏览器连接。
zh:browser.releaseFailed.en: {name} couldn't close the old browser connection.

zh:browser.releaseWaiting.en: The old browser connection is still closing.

zh:browser.switchOwn.text: 将 {name} 切换到其专用浏览器

zh:browser.versionUpdate.text: 设置前请将 {browser} 更新到 {minimum} 或更高版本。此电脑上的版本为 {major}。
zh:browser.versionUpdate.en: Update {browser} to version {minimum} or later before setup. This computer has version {major}.

zh:browser.versionUnknown.text: 请在“关于 {browser}”中查看其版本。此连接方式需要 {minimum} 或更高版本。
zh:browser.versionUnknown.en: Check About {browser} for its version. This route needs version {minimum} or later.

zh:browser.setupList.text: {count} 个机器人需要设置 Chrome。显示列表
zh:browser.setupList.en: {count} bots need Chrome setup. Show list

zh:browser.setupCount.text: {count} 个机器人选择了“我的 Chrome（已登录）”。请在此处完成连接。
zh:browser.setupCount.en: {count} bots chose My Chrome, signed in. Finish connecting them here.

zh:browser.closeFailed.text: {name} 的浏览器未能关闭。轻点“重启”以重试。
zh:browser.closeFailed.en: {name}'s browser didn't close. Tap Restart to try again.

zh:browser.directScope.text: {name} 会在其专用标签页中使用你的登录信息。Murage 会将机器人限制在这些标签页内，并将密码和付款操作交还给你处理。按网站设置和询问级别仅适用于“我的 Chrome（已登录）”。
zh:browser.directScope.en: {name} uses your logins in its own tabs. Murage keeps the bot to those tabs and hands passwords and payments back to you. Per-site choices and ask levels belong to My Chrome, signed in.
zh:browser.directScope.note: Reason: Use 登录状态 to describe existing signed-in sessions rather than access to credentials. Corrected string: {name} 会在其专用标签页中使用你的登录状态。Murage 会将机器人限制在这些标签页内，并将密码和付款操作交还给你处理。按网站设置和询问级别仅适用于“我的 Chrome（已登录）”。

zh:browser.extensionScope.text: {name} 可以以你的登录身份使用你共享的标签页。你可以为每个网站设置访问权限，涉及发送、发布或更改内容的操作需要单独批准。
zh:browser.extensionScope.en: {name} can use tabs you share, signed in as you. You choose each site's access, and actions that send, post or change something need separate approval.
zh:browser.extensionScope.note: Reason: Full access can send and submit without separate approval, so the current approval promise is too broad. Corrected string: {name} 可以以你的登录身份使用你共享的标签页。你可以为每个网站设置访问权限，并选择机器人在点击、输入、发送或发布前询问你的频率。

zh:browser.extensionUnavailable.text: 请更新 Murage 以设置 Murage for Chrome。
zh:browser.extensionUnavailable.en: Update Murage to set up Murage for Chrome.

zh:browser.continueWithout.text: 选择“暂不”可在不使用它的情况下继续。
zh:browser.continueWithout.en: Choose Not now to continue without it.

zh:browser.profileReady.text: 你用于 {name} 的 {browser} 配置文件已连接。准备好后请选择“继续”。

zh:browser.profileWaiting.en: Open {browser} with Murage for Chrome to connect your profile for {name}. Your task has not restarted.

zh:browser.connectedContinue.text: 已连接一个浏览器配置文件。准备好后请选择“继续”。

zh:browser.cause.builtin_missing.message.text: 请重新安装 Murage 以恢复缺失的浏览器文件。

zh:browser.cause.builtin_check_failed.me.text: 请再次尝试检查浏览器。

zh:browser.cause.chrome_status_unknown.m.text: 打开 Chrome 并检查其远程调试设置。
zh:browser.cause.chrome_status_unknown.m.en: Open Chrome and check its remote debugging setting.

zh:browser.disclosure.destination.text: 从现在起，{name} 将使用 {browser}，配置文件“{profile}”{shared}{application}。{accounts}。

zh:browser.disclosure.guest.text: 访客模式每次都从空白开始，不保留任何内容
zh:browser.disclosure.guest.en: Guest starts empty each time; nothing is kept

zh:browser.disclosure.floor.text: 此浏览器不会按网站询问，也不会检查每项操作。但仍会将密码和付款操作交还给你处理。
zh:browser.disclosure.floor.en: This browser doesn't ask per site or check each action. It still hands passwords and payments back to you.

zh:browser.disclosure.direct.text: 在独立的标签页中使用你的登录信息。按网站设置和询问级别仅适用于“我的 Chrome（已登录）”。
zh:browser.disclosure.direct.en: Uses your logins in tabs of its own. Per-site choices and ask levels belong to My Chrome, signed in.
zh:browser.disclosure.direct.note: Reason: 登录信息 suggests credentials rather than existing signed-in state. Corrected string: 在独立的标签页中使用你的登录状态。按网站设置和询问级别仅适用于“我的 Chrome（已登录）”。

zh:browser.disclosure.extension.text: 使用你的登录信息；由你选择其可访问的网站以及询问频率。
zh:browser.disclosure.extension.en: Uses your logins; you choose its sites and how often it asks.
zh:browser.disclosure.extension.note: Reason: Describe signed-in state rather than credentials. Corrected string: 使用你的登录状态；由你选择其可访问的网站以及询问频率。

zh:browser.disclosure.back.text: 你可以在“浏览器”标签页中切换回去。
zh:browser.disclosure.back.en: You can switch back in the Browser tab.

zh:browser.server.browser-extension-setu.en: Choose Set up before continuing with your browser.
